decision.reason: The only evidence, a one-line changelog entry [ev-5660e882c2ce], says Promtail now applies "excludepath" to newly added files. It doesn't say whether excludepath is a command-line flag, a scrape-config key or a target label, or how it is spelled. So the proposed cli-flag "--excludepath" condition has no support, and P1 also left applicability undetermined. To decide, I'd need the PR #9831 diff or the Promtail docs showing where excludepath is configured and which file-discovery conditions trigger the bug.
